_README: Every application this system may automate, keyed by app_id.
app_id names a VENDOR PRODUCT, not a tenant and not a URL — that indirection is what
lets one recorded capability serve many institutions running the same software.
Adding a target is a config change, not a code change. Nothing in src/ hardcodes a
hostname, a route, or a credential. To point this system at your own stack, copy the
'mock-bank' block, change base_url / entry_route / allowlist, set the two credential
env vars, and pass --app-id <your key> to the CLI.
Credentials are referenced BY ENV VAR NAME. Secrets never appear in this file, in an
artifact, in a transcript, or in the database.
Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored by the loader.

_note: Illustrative only — ignored by the loader. Shows what pointing at a different
deployment of the SAME vendor product looks like: a new base_url and credentials,
the same recorded capability. Per-tenant markup differences would be expressed as
tenant_overrides inside the artifact, not as a second recording.
